summary: Adams Street Credit Solutions Fund filed a Form 8-K reporting the routine sale of 113,268.541 Class I common shares in its continuous private offering for about $2.3 million (approximately $20.20 per share, equal to June 30, 2026 NAV), exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S. It also disclosed July 2026 monthly distribution of $0.15 per share payable August 10, 2026 to holders of record July 27, 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, or unusual mechanics. This is routine capital raising and distribution declaration, not a special situation.
